paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Yalkut on Isaiah, remez 256; Hyman says the name should read R' Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak, as in Bereshit Rabbah 28:7.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רנו totals 256 and סוף gives its end. כב״ר is contextually כ + ב״ר, as in Bereshit Rabbah, not the superseded Kohelet Rabbah guess; פ״כח״ז is read as parashah 28 section 7, without fresh edition verification. Yalkut on Isaiah is retained without adding Shimoni.

The heading supplies Shaman (שמן); Hyman directs correction to Shmuel (שמואל) based on his reported parallel. The indexed alias Shimon is not substituted. A prior note’s claim that this proves a corrupt form rather than a separate sage is bounded to Hyman’s proposal, with no canonical identity merger. Both abbreviated speaker titles remain R'; both full father titles remain Rav.
